# BRIEF.md

## What to build
- Walk, jump and look around on a small island floating in the sky
- Break blocks, pick them up, place them back (batch 1)

## What not to build
- Multiplayer, fighting monsters, crafting

## My ideas
- It rains, and you don't get wet standing under the edge of the roof

## Limits
- A static website that draws 3D with three.js, with no server, accounts or game engine
- At least 30 frames per second full screen on the school's old computers
- A world no bigger than 32 × 32 × 32 blocks, with textures only from the asset pack
@file:w7/seed7.js.## 第 1 批：挖 → 掉 → 撿 → 放（老師想的測試）\n\n### ST:
## Batch 1: break → drop → pick up → place (the teacher's tests)

### STEP 1 Break a block
- [ ] Hold the left button on dirt → cracks appear and grow, and the block is gone in under 1 second
- [ ] Click the left button just once → the block is still there (must not happen: it disappears with one click)
- [ ] Let go of the left button halfway → the cracks go away, and breaking starts over next time
- [ ] Break stone → takes longer than dirt, about 2 seconds

### STEP 2 It drops
- [ ] When a block disappears → a small block of the same kind pops out on the spot and turns slowly
- [ ] The small block lands and stops (must not happen: floating in the air or falling through the ground)

### STEP 3 Pick it up
- [ ] Walk up next to the small block → it flies to you, and the number in its hotbar slot goes +1
- [ ] Stand 3 blocks away → it is not picked up (must not happen)

### STEP 4 Place it back
- [ ] Select a slot with a number and right-click the ground → one block is placed, and the number goes −1
- [ ] The number in that slot is 0 → right-click does not place anything (must not happen)
- [ ] The whole chain: break one → pick it up → place it back → the number is back to what it was

- [ ] Step 5: Rain (R starts it, press again to stop) → must pass STEP 5
- [ ] Step 6: Crafting table (craft blocks into new things)

@file:w7/seed7.js.## TDD 規則\n- 一次只做 PLANS.md 的一步，做完停下來回報\n:
## TDD rules
- Do only one step of PLANS.md at a time, then stop and report
- Every step: write this step's tests first, run them once to confirm they fail, then commit
- Then write the code, commit only when all tests pass, and tick off the step in PLANS.md
- Do not change the tests just to make them pass
- Do not change VERIFY.md, it is mine; you may adjust PLANS.md yourself, and say what you changed in your report
